name: Santa Eulària Ibiza Marathon

trackSource.notes: On 2026-11-27 the marathon page linked Google Drive GPX and KMZ downloads and a PDF map named SEIM-2026-MAPA-MARATON.pdf; the GPX returned HTTP 404 and the KMZ link returned an HTML page instead of a file, so no track could be checked. The 2026 route came from an official KML whose URL was not recorded.

notes: On 2026-11-27 the marathon regulations page (https://ibizamarathon.es/en/marathon-regulations/) named the 2027 edition and gave a 3:45 p.m. start in a sentence without the year, while the marathon page said "Time: Soon.", so the start time was left unknown.
